title: 1952 official denial of secret development

tellings.quote: We can say that the recent sightings are in no way connected with any secret development by any department of the United States.

plain: In 1952, during a wave of UFO sightings over Washington, D.C., a US official told the public that "the recent sightings are in no way connected with any secret development by any department of the United States." The official is not named in the episode where the statement is played. It matters because it rules out the most common explanation, secret American aircraft, for what people were seeing.
